full_prompt_en: A stylized coastal painting shows a solitary dark figure beside a broad turquoise sea. The selected square scene is organized into sweeping horizontal layers beneath a subdued blue-violet sky. Along the distant water, pale cyan wave crests run from left to right, with a larger curling band of surf on the right. Closer to the viewer, luminous teal shallows alternate with dark navy stretches of wet sand. Their edges bend in shallow curves and pointed wedges rather than following perfectly straight stripes. The figure stands near the middle of the scene, facing the water, small and almost black against the brighter turquoise behind. A narrow lower silhouette meets a faint dark reflection on the wet shore. Clothing and facial details remain indistinct at this distance. The shore extends outward on both sides, leaving substantial open space around the single person. A curved white foam line crosses the middle foreground and brightens the boundary between a dark sandbar and clear blue-green water. Lower down, deep blue shapes alternate with brighter translucent-looking bands. Diffuse light produces smooth tonal transitions and pale highlights across the wave edges, without a strong cast shadow. The painting combines simplified silhouettes with softly brushed, layered color. Cool cyan, teal, navy, and muted violet dominate; the brightest accents remain chilly and nearly white. The small human presence and broad surrounding color fields establish a quiet, contemplative sense of scale.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅风格化海岸绘画，一道人影独自站在宽阔的绿松石色海边。选定的方形画面在低调蓝紫天空下展开层层横向曲线。远处浅青色浪脊自左向右延伸，右边有一条更明显的卷起浪带。靠近观者处，明亮青绿浅水与海军蓝湿沙交替出现，边缘弯成浅弧与尖角，并非笔直色条。人物位于画面中部附近，朝向水面，细小而近黑的身影衬在更亮的绿松石色前；收窄的下半身与湿岸上的淡暗倒影相接。这个距离下，衣服与面部细节难以辨明。岸线向两侧延展，在单独的人影周围留出大片空处。一道弯曲白色泡沫线横过中前景，照亮深色沙洲与清澈蓝绿水域的分界；更靠下处，深蓝形状与更亮、近乎通透的水带相互交错。漫射光令色调平滑过渡，并在浪缘留下浅色亮部，没有强烈投影。画面以简化剪影结合柔软刷绘的层次色彩，冷青、蓝绿、海军蓝和低调紫色占主导，最亮点仍偏冷并接近白色。微小人物与宽阔周围色域建立安静而沉思的尺度感。
style_prompt_en: A softly brushed, stylized painting combines simplified silhouettes with layered color. The palette is built from cool blues, cyan, teal and violet, arranged in broad tonal bands. Light areas transition smoothly into darker foreground values, while small pale accents provide focus without warming the overall image. Horizontal divisions create calm structure, and soft gradients keep boundaries from feeling mechanical. Contrast stays low to moderate; silhouettes and edges appear crisp against open fields, while surface marks remain sparse. The composition favors generous negative space and a stable horizontal axis, with color relationships doing more work than texture. The overall effect is cool, quiet and spacious, shaped by layered hues and restrained light.
style_prompt_zh: 柔软刷绘的风格化画面将简化剪影与层次色彩结合。色彩以冷蓝、青色、蓝绿和紫色构成，并铺排成宽阔明度带。浅色区域平滑过渡至较暗前景，少量浅色点缀建立焦点，却不改变画面的整体冷调。水平分层形成平静结构，柔和渐层避免边界显得机械。反差保持中低水平；剪影与轮廓在开阔色域前清晰可辨，表面纹理则十分稀疏。构图偏向保留宽阔负空间与稳定水平轴，让色彩关系承担比纹理更多的表现作用。整体效果冷静、安宁而开阔，来自层叠色相和克制光线。
theme_en: A solitary figure stands at the edge of a cool blue sea, with pale surf breaking along the right shoreline
theme_zh: 一道人影独自站在冷蓝色海边，右侧岸边有浅色浪花
name: Cool colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
